---
name: asrp-write
description: Draft or review an ASRP Structure record from confirmed architecture, ownership, policy, workflow, and evidence requirements.
---

# Write Structure

Identify confirmed actors, components, agents, responsibilities, interfaces,
dependencies, gates, entry points, artifacts, and evidence obligations. Preserve
unknowns outside the record rather than inventing them.

Author canonical `ape-structure-record/v1` JSON, run `asrp validate`, and keep
drafts inactive until the user confirms effective status.
